overall_summary: Analysis of the deduplicated performance metrics shows that space-themed content—specifically extreme planetary conditions, speculative 'What If' scenarios, and cosmic curiosities—significantly outperforms general psychology, standard biology facts, or historical trivia on both views-per-day and engagement (likes-per-view and comments-per-view). Videos published within the last 7 days focusing on planetary phenomena (e.g., Venus having a longer day than its year, falling into liquid diamond or dark planets) dominate the top tier of views and audience interaction. Older videos or psychological tips exhibit lower velocity and engagement, indicating audience fatigue with standard cognitive tricks.

winning_patterns.evidence: Videos like 'What If You Fell Into a Liquid Diamond Planet?' (IYuce8vaU3Y) and 'What If You Fell Into the Planet of Burning Ice?' (8KEl0_pJ_68) generated over 970-1,000+ views rapidly with high like ratios (up to 38 likes).
winning_patterns.action: Double down on high-concept cosmic 'What If' hooks that put the viewer directly into a dangerous, visually arresting extraterrestrial environment.

winning_patterns.evidence: 'Venus Has a Day Longer Than Its Year' (A9Qa-RmuOr0) and 'The Planet Darker Than Coal: TrES-2b' (v1rrcZLdp4U) pulled over 980-1,030 views with strong engagement.
winning_patterns.action: Continue producing short-form content featuring mind-bending, counter-intuitive space facts that challenge conventional physics.

weak_patterns.evidence: Videos like 'Your Brain Can Create Fake Memories' (2fqaGqfsR4A, 5 views) and 'The Psychological Trick to Stop Songs Stuck in Your Head' (ef3ND4qiRHc, 71 views) showed very low velocity and poor engagement.
weak_patterns.action: Deprioritize psychological trivia and common brain hack shorts as they fail to capture the immediate curiosity-driven retention of space content.

weak_patterns.evidence: Repeated animal basics like 'Octopuses Have THREE Hearts' (AXAfwrzzEdU, 118 views) underperform compared to high-end cosmic wonders.
weak_patterns.action: Shift animal-related content toward cinematic animal survival or extreme deep-sea mysteries rather than basic textbook facts.
